concerns.text: FR-003 (modify HiLS inference pipeline to use static lookup) and SC-002 (latency measurement) lack explicit implementation tasks. T026 implements the pipeline but does not explicitly cover the 'modification' aspect or the specific latency protocol (32k tokens, 10 runs, 2 warm-ups) required by FR-006/SC-002. T030 mentions 'moderate scale' which is insufficient coverage for the specific 32k requirement.

SC-005 requires measuring memory footprint of the 'dynamic retrieval module' using tracemalloc. T030b implements this but the description focuses on 'retrieval hook context' which may not fully cover the 'module' scope defined in the spec. Additionally, no task explicitly covers the 'comparison' aspect of SC-005 (measuring static index vs dynamic module) beyond the implementation of the measurement itself.

FR-008 requires a sensitivity analysis sweeping K over {50, 100, 200}. T031 implements this sweep but does not explicitly cover the 'reporting' of perplexity and QA accuracy trade-offs as required by FR-008. The task description only mentions 'appends results to a list' without specifying the report generation or analysis of trade-offs.

T005 (filter docs < 32k) and T013b (verify edge case logging for < 2048 tokens) create ambiguity. The spec distinguishes between document filtering (32k) and chunking thresholds (2048). T013b does not clearly distinguish which threshold it verifies, risking confusion between document filtering (T005) and chunking logic (T013). This is a writing issue in the task description clarity.

T030 specifies 'a token input of moderate scale' but FR-006 and SC-002 strictly require '32k token input context'. The task description uses vague language that does not trace cleanly to the specific quantitative requirement, potentially leading to untestable latency results. This is a writing issue in the task description.
